$comment: Golden response-shape contract for the wot_logger feature. Validates the WS command surface AND the on-flash log file shape AND the cloud upload payload shape. Each named field/section MUST appear as a literal in the corresponding firmware source (verified by eval.sh).

fields_in_data.success: bool — true on start, false on feature_manager refusal
fields_in_data.active_feature: string — feature_manager_active_name(), e.g. "wot_logger" on success or "none" otherwise

fields_in_data.success: bool — true on stop, false on feature_manager refusal

on_flash_log_file.file_format: RFC-1952 gzip stream wrapping CSV. Inside the wrapper, RFC-1951 DEFLATE in STORED mode (BTYPE=0) on target (P-64) — no actual compression, but valid gzip.

cloud_upload.body: raw gzip bytes from the on-flash file
cloud_upload.on_ack: wot_uploader deletes local file and decrements queue_count

$open_gates: HTTP 200 from cloud + local file delete on ack: verified end-to-end in a future HIL session (next on-car run); the capture → gzip → fopen legs are proven local-side post-c27abd9.
